code.description:
The problem code of its error (`SH1002`), or of its failure when
it ran and failed on the setup (`doctor`); `shuyi explain <code>`
prints its page.

error.description: Why it could not run, if it could not.

help.description: How to fix it, with the code.

limits.description: What it could not determine, in plain words.

ok.description:
Whether it passed: nothing found by a check, runs that agree, a
game made, a toolchain complete. False too when it could not run.

result.description: What it found or made; absent when it could not run.

ContentHash.description:
A fingerprint of a game's content: the same bytes give the same one on
every platform. Shown, and written to a file, as sixteen lowercase hex
digits, as a `StateHash` is shown (a string, since
JSON can't hold every `u64`).

hashes.description:
Each run's hash at that step; none for a run that has no such
step.

step.description: The first step whose hashes differ, or that only one run has.

Made.description:
What made a record or a save: the engine, the game's build and the
content it ran on, as the module docs say.

content.description: The fingerprint of the content it ran on.

game.description:
The game's word for its build (its name and version, say), as a
pack's stamp is.

first_difference.description: The first step where they differ, if they do.

made.description:
What made the record, if it says: the game's `replay` passes on
its record's stamp ([`turns`] leaves it `None`).

outcome.description: How the game ended, in the game's words, if it did.

steps.description: Step 0 (the state it starts in), then one step per command.

ReplayStep.description: One step of a run: the state after a command.

command.description: The command, in the game's words; none at step 0.

events.description: What it did, in the game's words.

hash.description: The state's hash after it (sixteen hex digits).

refused.description: Why the rules refused it, if they did (the state didn't change).

step.description: The step: 0 before any command, then the command's place from 1.
